class.name: BakedAnimations
class.brief_description: A character's animations recorded into textures, so crowds of it can be animated on the GPU.
class.description: A skinned character is slow in large numbers: each copy has a skeleton posed every frame. [BakedAnimations] records the character's animations once, every vertex's place in every frame, into textures; a [BakedAnimationMaterial] then plays them on the GPU, so an [InstanceGroup3D] can draw thousands of copies of the character, each in its own animation, as cheaply as still meshes. Bake it with [method bake], from the character in the scene and its [AnimationPlayer], in a tool script in the editor (then save it) or as the game loads: [codeblock] var baked := BakedAnimations.new() baked.bake($Walker, $Walker/AnimationPlayer, ["walk", "idle"]) ResourceSaver.save(baked, "res://crowd/walker_animations.res") [/codeblock] Draw [member mesh] with an [InstanceGroup3D] whose [member InstanceGroup3D.use_custom_data] is on and whose [member InstanceGroup3D.material_override] is a [BakedAnimationMaterial], and give each copy its animation and time with [method get_custom_data]. Animations are recorded in the character's own space, from the first [MeshInstance3D] under it with a [Skeleton3D]. Movement the skeleton doesn't make (the character's root moving) isn't recorded: move the copies yourself.

method.name: bake
method.description: Records [param animations] (all of [param player]'s if empty) of [param character], which must be in the scene tree, at [param frames_per_second]. Returns [constant OK], or an error if the character has no skinned mesh or there's nothing to bake. More frames a second play more smoothly; between frames the material blends.

method.name: get_animation_names
method.description: The names of the baked animations.

method.name: get_custom_data
method.description: A copy's custom data for [BakedAnimationMaterial]: [param animation] at [param time] seconds into it, looping if it loops and held at its end if it doesn't. Give it to the copy with [method InstanceGroup3D.set_custom_data].

method.name: get_length
method.description: How long [param animation] is, in seconds.

members.member: Each animation's name, and a [Vector4] of its first frame, how many frames it has, its frames a second, and [code]1[/code] if it loops.
